MERALCO, IBINIDA ANG HALOS 2 SENTIMO ROLLBACK SA SINGIL SA KURYENTE

Nag-anunsyo ang Manila Electric Company (Meralco) ng bahagyang rollback sa singil sa kuryente ngayong Mayo matapos nitong ibaba ang electricity rates ng ₱0.0151 kada kilowatt-hour (kWh).

Ayon sa Meralco, ang adjustment ay bahagi ng pagbawi sa naging pagtaas ng singil noong Abril at inaasahang magpapanatiling halos stable ang overall power rates ngayong buwan.

“Manila Electric Co. (Meralco) is cutting electricity rates by P0.0151 per kilowatt-hour (kWh) in May, reversing part of the increase imposed in April.”

(“Magbabawas ang Meralco ng ₱0.0151 kada kilowatt-hour ngayong Mayo bilang pagbawi sa bahagi ng ipinatupad na taas-singil noong Abril.”)

Dagdag pa rito:

“The adjustment will keep overall power rates largely stable this month for consumers after the previous billing cycle.”

(“Ang adjustment na ito ay inaasahang magpapanatiling halos matatag ang kabuuang singil sa kuryente ngayong buwan para sa mga consumer matapos ang nakaraang billing cycle.”)

Batay sa simpleng kalkulasyon:
• Ang household na gumagamit ng 200 kWh kada buwan ay makakakita lamang ng humigit-kumulang ₱3 bawas sa bill
• Ang gumagamit naman ng 500 kWh ay nasa ₱7.55 lamang ang magiging bawas

Sa ngayon, wala pang inilalabas na detalyadong breakdown ang Meralco hinggil sa naturang adjustment. Gayunman, naging usap-usapan ito online dahil sa liit ng rollback sa gitna ng patuloy na mataas na gastusin sa kuryente at iba pang pangunahing bilihin.

AKBAYAN TO CAYETANO-LED SENATE: PROVE COUP ISN’T A COVER-UP FOR SARA, BATO, AND ALLIES

Akbayan Party, part of the civil society coalition Tindig Pilipinas, marched to the Senate on Wednesday to demand that senators immediately convene as an impeachment court, stop protecting allies implicated in corruption, and surrender Senator Ronald “Bato” dela Rosa to face accountability before the International Criminal Court (ICC). The protest was joined by Mamamayang Liberal Partylist, Magdalo, SENTRO Labor Center, Student Council Alliance of the Philippines (SCAP), Akbayan Youth, as well as various church and sectoral leaders. 

The protest came amid mounting public fears that the leadership coup that installed Alan Peter Cayetano as Senate President was part of a broader effort to shield twice-impeached Vice President Sara Duterte from impeachment proceedings, along with other senators linked to the multibillion-peso flood-control corruption scandal.

Akbayan challenged Cayetano to prove that the Senate leadership shake-up was not engineered to bury the impeachment proceedings and suppress investigations into corruption.

“The House of Representatives has already fulfilled its constitutional duty by impeaching Sara based on strong evidence presented during multiple hearings. Ang tanong: gagawin ba ng Senado, sa ilalim ni Cayetano, ang tungkulin nito, o magiging protektor ito ng mga korap? Huwag naman sanang maging lutong kaldero ito. Hinahamon ng mamamayan si Cayetano na agad i-convene ang impeachment court at litisin si Vice President Sara,” said Akbayan President Rafaela David.

The progressive political party also slammed the sudden reappearance of dela Rosa after his prolonged absence amid reports of a possible ICC arrest warrant tied to the Duterte administration’s bloody drug war. “The Senate must immediately surrender Bato to the authorities. Huwag sanang madapa ang Senado gaya ni Bato. The Senate has no place for a senator who abandons his duties to evade accountability, only to resurface in a last-ditch effort to save Sara and destabilize the institution,” the group said

Akbayan warned that the Senate risks completely losing public credibility if it continues to prioritize narrow political interests over accountability. “Kapag ginamit ang Senado para protektahan sina Sara, Bato, at mga senador na sangkot sa flood-control corruption, hindi na ito isang kagalang-galang na institusyon kundi isang hideout na lamang ng mga magnanakaw, mamamatay-tao, at iba pang abusado,” David said.

David added that the group would sustain public pressure until the impeachment court is convened and accountability mechanisms are allowed to proceed. “Simple lang ang panawagan ng taumbayan: itigil ang pagtatanggol sa mga corrupt, sundin ang Konstitusyon, litisin si Sara Duterte, at isuko si Bato. No Senate coup, delay, or sabotage will stop the people’s demand for justice and accountability.”

LOOK: Various civil society coalitions, including Alab ng Bayan and Tindig Pilipinas, led an indignation rally condemning the alleged “Senate coup” that resulted in changes in the Senate leadership, which they described as a desperate move to block the continuation of the impeachment trial against twice-impeached Vice President Sara Duterte.

The groups also criticized the Senate leadership for allegedly protecting Senator Ronald dela Rosa, whom they accused in connection with alleged mass killings, and called for his immediate arrest.

The protest, held in front of the Senate in Pasay City on May 13, 2026, was joined by various religious groups, civil society organizations, and advocacy groups.

Photo by Jonas Sulit, Abante

Partikular na sinabi ni MMDA Chairman Atty. Don Artes ang assistance sa NCRCOM sa mga operasyon katulad ng rally, bagyo, lindol, at iba pang mga emerhensya sa Metro Manila.

Nagpasalamat din ang mga ahensiya sa bukas na koordinasyon at pagtutulungan upang higit pang mapaigting ang disaster preparedness ng Metro Manila.
